description: NaPbFe₂F₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra and edges with four FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.80 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with four FeF₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-45°. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (1.96 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are four shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Pb-F bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.63 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Fe atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Fe atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one Pb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one Pb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one Pb atom.
